• Type: stem plant
  • Origin: Asia
  • Growth rate: medium
  • Height: 10 - 30+ cm
  • Light demand: high
  • CO2 demand: high

Rotala wallichii is a demanding plant that develops red shoot tips in good light conditions. The most decorative effect can be achieved by planting a large number of stems in a group. It is easy to prune if it grows too tall. CO2 addition boosts growth considerably. It also prefers soft, slightly acidic water.
Good as a background and midground plant, and suitable even for small aquariums because it is easy to prune if it grows too tall.
